questions.stem: What is the name of a quadrilateral with two pairs of adjacent sides of equal length?
questions.solution: A kite is a quadrilateral with two pairs of adjacent sides that are equal in length. A rectangle and a square have opposite sides that are equal, not adjacent. A rhombus has all four sides equal, not just two adjacent pairs. Therefore, the correct answer is Kite.

questions.stem: What is the sum of the angles in a quadrilateral?
questions.solution: The sum of the interior angles in any quadrilateral is always 360°, which can be derived by dividing the quadrilateral into two triangles, each with 180°. The other options do not match this geometric principle. 180° is the sum for a triangle, 270° and 450° are not valid angle sums for any quadrilateral.

hi.stem: एक चतुर्भुज के कोणों का योग क्या होता है?

questions.stem: Which of the following is a property of a square?
questions.solution: A square is defined as a quadrilateral with all sides of equal length. This makes 'All sides are equal' the correct option. The other options are incorrect because a square has opposite sides equal but not just 'only' opposite sides, all angles in a square are 90°, not 60°, and the diagonals of a square are equal in length.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a property of a rectangle?
questions.solution: One of the properties of a rectangle is that all angles are equal to 90°. This is a defining characteristic of a rectangle. The first option is incorrect because not all sides are equal in a rectangle. The third and fourth options are incorrect because the diagonals of a rectangle are equal and not perpendicular. The correct answer is that all angles are equal to 90°.

questions.stem: In a rectangle, which of the following is always true?
questions.solution: In a rectangle, one of the key properties is that the diagonals bisect each other. This is true for all rectangles. The first option is incorrect because diagonals in a rectangle are not perpendicular unless it is a square. questions.stem: In a parallelogram, two adjacent angles are in the ratio 1:2. What is the measure of the smaller angle?
questions.solution: In a parallelogram, adjacent angles are supplementary. If the ratio is 1:2, the angles are x and 2x. So, x + 2x = 180°, which gives x = 60°. The other options are incorrect because they do not satisfy the condition of supplementary angles in a parallelogram.

hi.stem: एक समचतुर्भुज में, विकर्णों के बीच कोण का माप क्या है?
hi.solution: एक समचतुर्भुज में, विकर्ण हमेशा समकोण पर प्रतिच्छेद करते हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि उनके बीच कोण 90° होता है। यह समचतुर्भुज का एक मूलभूत ज्यामितीय गुण है। अन्य विकल्प इस गुण को संतुष्ट नहीं करते हैं और इसलिए गलत हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate geometric terminology as found in Hindi-medium textbooks.

mr.stem: एका चौरसात, विकर्णांमधील कोनाचे माप किती असते?
mr.solution: चौरसात, विकर्ण अंगावर लंब असतात, जे त्यांच्यातील कोन 90° असतो. हे चौरसाच्या भूमितीय गुणधर्माचे एक मूलभूत गुणधर्म आहे. इतर विकल्प या गुणधर्माला अनुरूप नसतात आणि म्हणूनच ते चुकीचे आहेत.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate Marathi geometry terminology.

questions.stem: If a quadrilateral has diagonals that bisect each other at 90°, which of the following must it be?
questions.solution: A rhombus is defined by having diagonals that bisect each other at 90°, which is a unique characteristic. A parallelogram's diagonals bisect each other but do not necessarily intersect at 90°, a rectangle's diagonals are equal and bisect each other but not at 90°, and a trapezium does not have diagonals that bisect each other at 90°. Therefore, the quadrilateral must be a rhombus.

hi.stem: यदि एक चतुर्भुज के विकर्ण 90° पर एक दूसरे को समद्विभाजित करते हैं, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा आवश्यक रूप से होना चाहिए?
hi.solution: समचतुर्भुज की परिभाषा में विकर्ण एक दूसरे को 90° पर समद्विभाजित करते हैं, जो एक विशिष्ट विशेषता है। समांतर चतुर्भुज के विकर्ण एक दूसरे को समद्विभाजित करते हैं लेकिन आवश्यक रूप से 90° पर नहीं होते हैं, आयत के विकर्ण बराबर होते हैं और एक दूसरे को समद्विभाजित करते हैं लेकिन 90° पर नहीं होते हैं, और समलम्ब चतुर्भुज के विकर्ण 90° पर एक दूसरे को समद्विभाजित नहीं करते हैं। इसलिए, चतुर्भुज आवश्यक रूप से समचतुर्भुज होना चाहिए।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses standard Hindi geometry terminology.

mr.stem: एका चौकोनाच्या विकर्ण एकमेकांना 90° वर दुभागतात, तर खालीलपैकी कोणता त्याचा अवश्य असावा?
mr.solution: समभुज चौकोन विकर्ण एकमेकांना 90° वर दुभागतात, हे त्याचे विशिष्ट लक्षण आहे. समांतर चौकोनाच्या विकर्ण एकमेकांना दुभागतात परंतु 90° वर अवश्य नसतात, आयताच्या विकर्ण समान असतात आणि एकमेकांना दुभागतात परंतु 90° वर नसतात आणि समलंब चौकोनाच्या विकर्ण एकमेकांना 90° वर दुभागत नाहीत. म्हणून, चौकोन समभुज चौकोन असावा.
